text:
Catalog CC-042
1) The dossier describes a forged reviewer network recruited to inflate acceptance rates, filed under Editorial Integrity, with a pending referral to Ethics never entered.
2) Records detail coordinated rejection campaigns targeting a named competitor, indexed by manuscript ID, while the conflict-of-interest cross-reference remains blank.
3) Correspondence shows fabricated independence assurances sent to journal staff, cataloged under Peer Review Fidelity, but the audit trail link was omitted.
4) A list of recruited reviewers with incentive terms appears in the file, shelved under Research Misconduct, awaiting the mandatory COI disclosure cross-reference.
5) Metadata indicates systematic manipulation of the editorial system's independence checks, filed under System Integrity, with the forensic review cross-reference left empty.
6) The final card notes institutional escalation recommendations, placed under Academic Governance, where the whistleblower protection cross-reference was never added.
